[[Category:Glasgow Name Study]]

== Biography ==
Based on their children's birthplaces listed in the 1860 census, the family moved from Ohio to Iowa sometime between 1850 and 1856.

Joseph was born in 1821. He was the son of [[Glasgow-1965|John Glasgow]] and [[Finley-3735|Margaret Finley]].  He passed away in 1897.
